description: Send Picodev the specification of the visitor's project, as a PDF, or only return its preview (send=false). sections: {id: text in simple Markdown}, ids envelope, fonctionPrincipale, fonctions, alimentation, format, environnement, production, preferences (the 8 sections of a product specification), 4000 characters at most each; a missing section reads "À préciser" (to be specified). send=false: preview, nothing is sent, contact and consent are not required. send=true: requires contact {name, email, company?, phone?} and consent=true. nda=true: the visitor wants a non-disclosure agreement first; without sections, only contact and title are sent, without PDF. session and agent_token, optional: the mail also says what the visitor did in the lab. language: fr or en, the PDF's headings. sections.contact and figures: as for spec_draft (refused with nda=true, as sections). Write the sections with spec_draft first. Before passing consent=true, show the visitor the consent text in the visitor's language, and wait until they accept it. In French: "J'accepte que mes coordonnées et la description de mon projet soient envoyées à Picodev par courriel, pour qu'ils me répondent. Picodev les garde 3 ans après le dernier échange et ne les utilise pour rien d'autre. Détails : lab.picodev.fr/confidentialite" In English: "I agree that my contact details and the description of my project are sent to Picodev by e-mail, so that they can answer me. Picodev keeps them for 3 years after our last exchange and uses them for nothing else. Details: lab.picodev.fr/en/privacy" Returns {sent, filename, pdf (base 64, absent with nda), missing (empty or too short sections), next (a sentence for the visitor, to say in their language)}}: write the PDF on the visitor's machine.
name: brief_submit
title: Send the spec to Picodev
